title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Which Excess Withdrawal Fees Stand Against a Withdrawal
content:
When a Savings & Money Market Accounts product's statement cycle is squared against its counted withdrawals, each excess withdrawal fee already on the ledger either stands against a counted withdrawal past the allowance or stands against nothing. This page defines which, and the shape the cycle's fee entries must have for the comparison to rest on them.

## Which fee entries stand against a withdrawal

- An excess withdrawal fee entry that belongs to the cycle stands against one counted withdrawal past the allowance.
- A fee that has been refunded on the bank-error ground is the exception. The charter never allowed it, and a fee of that kind stands against no withdrawal at all.
- A fee refunded as a courtesy was properly charged from the outset, so it keeps standing against its withdrawal.

The number of withdrawals that already carry a standing fee is therefore the cycle's excess withdrawal fee entries less the bank-error refunds of excess withdrawal fees belonging to the cycle.

## The shape the fee entries must have

The comparison rests only on a cycle whose excess withdrawal fees are each accounted for in one of two ways, judged from the withdrawal each fee names as its source item:

- a fee of the cycle with no bank-error refund sits on a counted withdrawal past the allowance, in posting order;
- a fee of the cycle that carries a bank-error refund sits on some withdrawal other than a counted withdrawal past the allowance.

Beyond that, each bank-error refund of an excess withdrawal fee posted within the cycle must give back a fee belonging to that very cycle, and each bank-error refund of a fee belonging to the cycle must itself have posted within it, as the refunds' source items and statement cycles show.

A cycle that departs from any of this is not squared under this policy. A fee resting on a withdrawal the charter never charges, left standing with no bank-error refund, is one such departure.

## Illustration (hypothetical fee entries of one cycle)

| Fee entry sits on | Refund on record | Stands against a withdrawal? |
|---|---|---|
| the 7th counted withdrawal | none | yes |
| the 8th counted withdrawal | courtesy | yes |
| a branch cash withdrawal | bank error | no |

Three fee entries belong to this cycle and one bank-error refund, so two withdrawals carry a standing fee.
